contexts.text: The ways which lead to the Spiritual Kingdom appear adorned with vineyards and laurels... because vineyards and laurels correspond to the affection of truth, and its uses.
Decorated with the laurel of the tutorship.
I saw a garden... where were olives, vines, figs, laurels, and palms; set in order according to correspondence.
I walked in the garden, and saw some sitting under a certain laurel, eating figs...
Nine men, each wearing a laurel wreath, the glory of his reputation... The Angel addressed the nine laureates...
The quicker boys receive some leaves of laurel as a prize.
An avenue of palms and laurels, (which) terminated in a garden, in the midst of which was the Temple of Wisdom.
We entered the Heaven (of the Copper Age) on the southern side; and there was there a magnificent grove of palms and laurels.
To those who were at the east, the Angel gave laurel wreaths, in which were rubies and sapphires.
Then the laureates... asked. What is new from the earth?
There appeared in the eastern quarter a grove of palms and laurels, set in spiral gyres (which led into the garden Adramandoni).
This wreath (which consisted of a garland of flowers) is given you, because from childhood you have meditated about Heaven and Hell.
I saw three men like laureates...

I observed a number of Spirits, whose heads were encircled with leaves of laurel, and who were clothed in flowered robes; which signified that they were Spirits who in the natural world had been renowned for the reputation of erudition.

Those who, from modern orthodoxy, teach concerning faith, appear to the Angels as if wearing a wreath made of the leaves of the bay-oak; whereas those who teach from the Word concerning charity and its works, appear to the Angels as if adorned with a wreath woven of the odoriferous leaves of the laurel.
